arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
arcane_bolt.desc: A bolt of raw arcane force. Strength follows local Resonance and the caster's aptitude.

mend_wounds.name: Mend Wounds
mend_wounds.desc: A short prayer that closes wounds. Divine magic leans on Resonance less than arcane.

identify.name: Identify
identify.desc: Read an item's binding pattern. Reveals enchantments and curses. Easier where Resonance runs high. A failed attempt can't be retried until tomorrow.

divine_sight.name: Divine Sight
divine_sight.desc: Ask the gods what an object is. Reveals curses. Leans on Resonance less than Identify.
